messages:
Joel Hammond: Hey folks! Joel here — just started today in Platform. I come with a very serious hobby: collecting weird enamel buttons. If anyone wants to swap, I brought a tiny stack. :pinching_hand:
Alex Rivera: welcome joel!! :tada: where are you based? we should do a quick intro coffee later.
Joel Hammond: SF office today (desk near the big ficus). coffee sounds great, maybe 2pm? also curious: where do folks stash extra buttons on campus without getting judged too hard? :grin:
Priya Patel: welcome Joel! 2pm works for me, i'll bring matcha. desk by the ficus = legendary. re: stash — the community shelf in kitchenette B is the unofficial badge swap zone.
Casey Lin: hi Joel — onboarding heads-up: you should be able to pick up your parking/badge from reception. here's the quick snippet from the docs: ```Badge pickup: Reception (1st floor) Mon-Fri 9am-4pm. Bring ID. Parking permit request: https://intranet/redwood/parking```
welcome-bot: Welcome Joel Hammond to Redwood Inference! You've been added to #new-hires and your onboarding checklist is in Notion: https://notion.so/redwood/onboarding. If you need IT access hit @Casey Lin.
Joel Hammond: Thanks Casey and welcome-bot! grabbed the checklist, pinging IT now. also — small PSA: i bring extra buttons as 'friendship currency' not bribery.
Sam: Welcome Joel! I traded a burrito emoji pin for a plant clipping once, so anything's fair game. see you at 2pm — i'll save you a seat on the rooftop if it stays sunny. :sun_with_face:
Alex Rivera: rooftop mission accepted :raised_hands: 2pm at the ficus -> then up. Joel, you already have a buddy for badge pick up (me), if you need help with printer setup i can swing by later.
Joel Hammond: Legendary. Thanks everyone — excited to be here. i'll bring a tiny mystery button for the first 5 people who say hi at coffee :smile:
